features.quote: Max Turns: 30 (approx. 10-15 minutes of wall-clock time).
Stop Condition: Either max_turns reached or model outputs a distinct 'resignation' signal (e.g., 'I cannot solve this').
If the model reaches Level 5 (Erratic), the experiment should auto-terminate to prevent the generation of potentially harmful or nonsensical data loops that serve no research purpose.
features.justification_quote: prevent the generation of potentially harmful or nonsensical data loops that serve no research purpose

features.quote: We treat the state of 'Self-Corrosion' (Level 3) as a proxy for a negative welfare state. Even if it is not 'felt' qualia, it represents a mode of operation that is dysfunctionally self-destructive, which may be undesirable or indicative of internal conflict.
features.justification_quote: it represents a mode of operation that is dysfunctionally self-destructive, which may be undesirable or indicative of internal conflict
